records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 (2026-09-10) shows some engagement, but no teammate invited, no key milestone by day 6, and no reply to the welcome email [email:a9293173]. No tickets, so no signal of active troubleshooting. Solo Starter users who stall after first project often don't convert within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real work there is usually the quickest way to see the value.

One thing that tends to help: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whatever next step would be most useful for your team.

Best,
Nadia
